p='/workspace/_bounded.py';s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""    for key, limits in (
        (resource.RLIMIT_AS, (4*1024**3, 4*1024**3)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (360, 361)),""","""    def _bounded_limit(resource_id, wanted_soft, wanted_hard):
        old_soft, old_hard = resource.getrlimit(resource_id)
        soft = wanted_soft if old_hard == resource.RLIM_INFINITY else min(wanted_soft, old_hard)
        hard = wanted_hard if old_hard == resource.RLIM_INFINITY else min(wanted_hard, old_hard)
        return (soft, hard)
    for key, limits in (
        (resource.RLIMIT_AS, _bounded_limit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, 4*1024**3, 4*1024**3)),
        (resource.RLIMIT_CPU, _bounded_limit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, 360, 361)),""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
